items.summary_zh: TidePool（项目名 FtpPool）是面向 FTP/FTPS 的高性能连接池，针对 FTPClient 有状态、易失效的痛点，归还连接时自动重置工作目录、传输模式与编码，重置失败即销毁，不把坏连接放回池中。默认 hybrid 配置走 FastPoolEngine 的 CAS 快速路径，另备 Commons Pool 引擎，自带指标、JMX、泄漏检测与 Spring Boot Starter，Apache-2.0 开源。
items.summary_en: TidePool, whose project name is FtpPool, is a connection pool for FTP/FTPS that resets each FTPClient's working directory, transfer mode and encoding when a connection is returned, destroying it instead if the reset fails so broken connections never go back into the pool. It defaults to a FastPoolEngine CAS fast path with a Commons Pool alternative, and ships metrics, JMX, leak detection and a Spring Boot starter under Apache-2.0. Java teams whose FTP clients keep going stale are the intended audience.

items.title: Solaris 早已淡出视野，它的“转门”却还藏在 Go、WebKit 和 Rust 里
items.summary_zh: Solaris 虽已淡出视野，但它的转门（turnstile）机制仍活在现代系统里：等待状态被从锁结构中拆出，阻塞线程把预分配的转门交给锁，用一张以锁虚拟地址为键、按桶组织的全局哈希表维护优先级继承链，使无竞争的锁只占一字节左右，代价是高竞争时要付出哈希桶查找和总线同步。文章梳理了 Go 运行时 sema.go 的 semtable、WebKit 与 Rust 中同源的思路，也回顾了 Slab 分配器、ZFS、DTrace、Zones 等遗产。
items.summary_en: Though Solaris has largely faded from view, its turnstile mechanism survives in modern runtimes: waiting state is split off from the lock structure, so a blocking thread hands a pre-allocated turnstile to the lock and priority inheritance is tracked through a bucketed global hash table keyed by the lock's virtual address, keeping uncontended locks at about a byte. The article traces the same idea in Go's runtime sema.go and semtable, WebKit and Rust, and revisits Slab allocators, ZFS, DTrace and Zones.

items.title: React Native 的黄金时代，在 AI 手里结束了
items.summary_zh: Shopify 宣布旗下移动应用从 React Native 退回 Swift 与 Kotlin 原生开发，消费者应用 Shop 只用 12 周就发布全原生版本；此时 React Native 刚结束历时六年的新架构重写，Hermes V1 默认启用。Shopify 工程总监 Mustafa Ali 称 LLM 改变了 2020 年选择 RN 时的核心前提，Agent 已能承担大量实现、翻译与测试工作。
items.summary_en: Shopify is moving its mobile apps off React Native back to native Swift and Kotlin, leaning on coding agents for the rewrite; its consumer Shop app shipped a fully native version in 12 weeks. The shift came right after React Native finished a six-year architecture rewrite with Hermes V1 on by default, and engineering director Mustafa Ali said LLMs changed the core premise behind its 2020 decision.

items.title: 九问 ScienceDiscovery：从纳米抗体到大飞机，AI 如何从“给答案”走向“做研究”
items.summary_zh: 华为 HC 大会上，openJiuwen ScienceDiscovery 以纳米抗体智造和民机气动设计两个案例，展示如何把文献阅读、假设提出、代码开发与实验试错放进同一工作环境。它把输出结论关联到执行记录与引用证据，以应对工具碎片化和科研幻觉，目标是让 AI 从给答案走向可验证的做研究，广州实验室的抗体智造系统是其中实践。
items.summary_en: At Huawei's HC conference, openJiuwen ScienceDiscovery presented two cases, nanobody design and civil aircraft aerodynamic design, that put literature reading, hypothesis generation, coding and experiment iteration into one environment. Its review and traceability design links outputs to execution records and cited evidence to counter fragmented tooling and research hallucination, aiming to move AI from giving answers to doing verifiable research.

items.title: AI 时代架构往哪走？快手 AI 时代的架构演进思路｜QCon上海
items.summary_zh: 2026 年 QCon 全球软件开发大会上海站将于 10 月 22 日至 24 日举办，方向覆盖 AI Native 架构、Agent Runtime、AI Infra 与 Agent 安全可观测等。快手架构治理团队及 AI 架构演进负责人刘中兵将在该专题分享快手的 AI 原生架构打法，涉及 Agent 各自为政形成烟囱、Token 成本失控和 AI 生成代码缺少规范等落地难题。
items.summary_en: QCon Shanghai 2026 runs October 22–24, covering AI Native architecture, Agent Runtime, AI Infra, and agent security and observability. Liu Zhongbing, who leads architecture governance and AI architecture evolution at Kuaishou, will present the company's approach in the AI Native architecture track, including agent silos, runaway token costs and ungoverned AI-generated code.

items.title: .NET 11 RC1 来了：C# 15 转正，联合类型却引发争议
items.summary_zh: .NET 11 RC1 发布并附带 Go-Live 许可，可用于生产环境，C# 15 与 F# 11 成为默认语言版本，联合类型、集合表达式参数、封闭类层次结构等预览功能转为稳定版。F# 的字符串插值改编译为 String.Concat 以配合裁剪和 Native AOT，dotnet test 新增对 Android、iOS、macOS 测试项目的支持。
items.summary_en: Microsoft released .NET 11 RC1 with a Go-Live license so teams can use it in production; C# 15 and F# 11 are the default language versions, with union types, collection expression parameters and closed class hierarchies moving from preview to stable. F# string interpolation now compiles to String.Concat for trimming and Native AOT, and dotnet test can run projects targeting Android, iOS and macOS.

items.title: Bitrise Remote Dev Environments
items.description: Cloud Macs your coding agents can actually build on
items.summary_zh: Bitrise 在 Product Hunt 上线 Remote Dev Environments，提供云端 Mac 环境，主打让 coding agent 能真正在其上完成构建。适合需要为自动化编码智能体提供 macOS 构建能力、又不想自己维护 Mac 机器的团队。
items.summary_en: Bitrise has launched Remote Dev Environments on Product Hunt: cloud Macs that, per the tagline, coding agents can actually build on. It targets teams that need macOS build capability for automated coding agents without maintaining their own Mac hardware. The listing itself carries no further detail beyond that description.

items.title: I built non-autoregressive decision models with RL a year ago
items.author: nandakishor_ml
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者表示自己在一年前用 RL 做出了非自回归的决策模型：单次前向传播即可覆盖 100 多种语言，在 GPU 上耗时约 33ms，基于 RLCD 与 proper scoring rules 构建，来自 Convai Innovations。这类做法的看点是绕开逐 token 生成，把多语言推理压进一次前向计算里。
items.summary_en: A developer says he built non-autoregressive decision models with RL a year ago: one forward pass covers 100+ languages at roughly 33ms on GPU, built with RLCD and proper scoring rules by Convai Innovations. The point is skipping token-by-token decoding and folding multilingual inference into a single pass, which matters to anyone dealing with latency-sensitive models.

items.title: Atlassian 通过关联指标、日志与追踪链路实现根因分析自动化
items.summary_zh: Atlassian 在 CNCF 发布了一套自动化根因分析方案，用 OpenTelemetry 服务依赖图圈定相关服务，再分别检测指标、追踪与日志的异常，对齐到统一时间线后按依赖向上游回溯，输出排序后的故障假设。它针对的是工程师跨多个可观测性平台手动拼接遥测信号的痛点，模块化设计让各异常检测器可独立演进。
items.summary_en: Atlassian has published a root-cause-analysis system at the CNCF that narrows scope with an OpenTelemetry service map, runs separate anomaly detectors over metrics, traces and logs, aligns them on a shared timeline, then walks upstream through the dependency graph to rank hypotheses about origin and propagation. It targets the slowest part of incident response, where engineers stitch telemetry together across fragmented dashboards, and keeps each detector independently evolvable.

items.title: Text Agent Store
items.description: A marketplace for AI agents you can text
items.summary_zh: Text Agent Store 是一个 AI agent 交易市场，主打用短信（text）与 agent 交互，让用户通过文字消息找到并调用 agent，而不是打开网页应用。它把 agent 的分发与触达放进短信界面，适合关注 agent 商业化与消息渠道的开发者。原文只提供一句简介，定价与平台支持未披露。
items.summary_en: Text Agent Store is a marketplace for AI agents you reach by text message, letting users find and invoke agents through a messaging interface instead of a web app. It sits at the intersection of agent distribution and messaging channels, and should interest developers thinking about how agents get discovered. Only a one-line description is provided, so pricing and platform support aren't specified.

items.summary_en: Modaal for Android lets developers ship to both app stores from a single project, mixing Swift and Kotlin in one codebase. It targets teams that already have Swift code and don't want to rewrite their app for Android. The listing gives only a one-line description, so build pipeline details and pricing aren't covered.

items.summary_en: Android 17 QPR1 is the first release since Android Honeycomb (3.x) to add new APIs for app developers without a matching release to the Android Open Source Project, according to the linked API diff 37.1. Those APIs currently ship only in Pixel OS and aren't available to other Android OEMs, so anyone targeting non-Pixel devices can't count on them yet.

items.title: trycua/cua
items.description: Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS fleets, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.
items.author: trycua
items.summary_zh: Cua 是一套面向 computer-use agent 的开源工具，包含桌面自动化驱动、隔离的云端桌面、本地 macOS VM、专用决策模型，以及用于训练、评测和数据生成的 benchmark。它同时提供 Cua Fleets，可跨操作系统批量管理这类 agent，适合需要训练或评估 computer-use agent 的团队。
items.summary_en: Cua is an open-source stack for computer-use agents: desktop automation drivers, isolated cloud desktops, local macOS VMs, specialist decision models, and benchmarks for training, evaluation and data generation. It also ships Cua Fleets for managing such agents across cross-OS fleets. Targeted at teams that need to train or evaluate agents operating real computers.

items.title: 最近公司烧token比招员工还贵，老板干懵了...

items.summary_zh: Uber 的 CTO 透露，公司自部署 Claude Code 后超九成工程师高频使用，原计划覆盖 2026 全年的 AI 预算在今年前 4 个月就烧光。掘金这篇文章由此批评把 token 消耗当 KPI 的 Tokenmaxxing 风气，并指出同一人同一天的用量能差十倍、与产品价值无直接相关性。
items.summary_en: A Juejin article reports that Uber's CTO says over 90% of its engineers now use Claude Code heavily, and that an AI budget meant to cover all of 2026 was exhausted in the first four months of this year. It argues against Tokenmaxxing — judging engineers by token consumption — noting usage swings tenfold for the same person and tool, and that token spend shows no direct correlation with product value.

items.summary_en: Bolt Forge is a new agent from Bolt that runs on open-source models and comes with what the team describes as 50X usage. That combination matters for developers who want agentic coding without being tied to one proprietary model or squeezed by a tight usage cap.

items.summary_en: A Juejin roundup of GitHub's top projects for May 2026, picking 10 from 17 candidates across engineering skill libraries, code knowledge graphs, multi-agent orchestration and automated video. The top entry, Matt Pocock's skills library, gained 65,737 stars in the month to pass 113.3K, while codegraph and Understand-Anything added roughly 34K and 37K. The shared thread is turning agents from one-off chats into reusable engineering workflows.

items.author: ethanhawksley

items.summary_en: Cloudflare Quick Tunnels expose a localhost service to the public internet over a free encrypted tunnel, with no account, DNS record, or open inbound port required. It fits developers who need a throwaway public URL for demos, webhook callbacks, or checking a local page from a remote device.

items.title: Claude Code now reads AGENTS.md if there is no Claude.md

items.summary_en: Claude Code now falls back to reading AGENTS.md when a project has no Claude.md, per its versioned release notes. That matters for teams running several AI coding agents, since one shared conventions file can now serve tools that follow the AGENTS.md convention instead of maintaining a separate instruction file per tool.

items.title: AI写长篇小说为什么30章必崩
items.description: AI写长篇小说为什么30章必崩？工程化解法详解 前言 你有没有试过用ChatGPT写小说？ 前几章写得挺好，角色鲜明、情节紧凑。但写到30章左右，突然发现：主角的妹妹名字变了，第5章埋的伏笔忘了回收，
items.summary_zh: 一位有 7 年编程经验的作者把 CI/CD 思路搬进 AI 写作流程，自研工具 NovelOps 跑通 270 章连载，并总结出长篇小说约 30 章必崩的三个结构性原因：跨章一致性丢失、节奏失控、叙事套路固化，它们都是跨章问题而非单章问题。文中给出的是经过实际验证的工程化解法，适合用 ChatGPT 写长篇却越写越崩的作者。
items.summary_en: A developer with seven years of coding experience applied CI/CD thinking to AI fiction writing and built a tool called NovelOps that carried a serialized novel to 270 chapters. The article breaks down three structural reasons AI novels collapse around chapter 30 — lost cross-chapter consistency, uncontrolled pacing, and frozen narrative patterns — arguing all three are cross-chapter rather than single-chapter problems. It presents an engineering fix that was actually run, aimed at anyone writing long fiction with ChatGPT.

items.summary_en: Using github.com as the example, the author notes its cookies contain just a single _gh_session value — Rails-encrypted session data — to explain why mainstream sites keep state on the server rather than packing it into a JWT. It is aimed at backend developers choosing an authentication strategy and wondering where JWTs actually fall short in production.
